questions.question: Which compositional layer forms Earth's outermost solid surface?
Which compositional layer lies between the crust and core?
What is the physical state of Earth's outer core?
What is the physical state of Earth's inner core?
Which metals are major components of Earth's core?
What is the asthenosphere?
choices: A comparatively weak, slowly deforming region of the upper mantle

questions.question: Which evidence is central to investigating inaccessible deep Earth layers?
Why can the inner core remain solid despite its high temperature?
choices: The inner core receives no heat
Its temperature is below room temperature
High pressure affects the melting conditions of its material

questions.question: Why is calling the entire mantle a liquid misleading?
choices: The mantle consists entirely of gas
Most mantle material is solid but can deform slowly over long times
All mantle rock is colder than surface ice

questions.question: How do temperature and pressure generally change with depth inside Earth?
choices: Temperature decreases while pressure stays zero
Both are identical at every depth

questions.question: What does the difference between continental and oceanic crust generally involve?
choices: Continental crust is thicker and less dense on average
Both have identical average composition and density

questions.question: How does the lithosphere differ from the crust?
choices: It consists only of liquid outer core
It is the same as the atmosphere
It includes the crust and rigid uppermost mantle

questions.question: Why do changes in seismic-wave speed suggest internal boundaries?
choices: Wave speed depends on material properties that change across layers
Boundary layers create new earthquakes automatically

questions.question: What process in the outer core helps generate Earth's magnetic field?
choices: Motion of electrically conducting liquid metal
Ocean waves turning into permanent magnets

questions.question: What provides a major continuing source of Earth's internal heat?
A layer does not transmit S waves but transmits P waves. Which interpretation fits a deep Earth layer?
choices: It must be the solid crust

questions.question: A diagram labels the center as solid and the surrounding metallic layer as liquid. Which labels fit?
A student says tectonic plates consist of crust alone. Which correction is appropriate?
choices: They are made only of the outer core
They include rigid uppermost mantle as well as crust
They contain atmosphere but no rock

questions.question: Two crust samples are compared: basalt-rich oceanic crust and granite-rich continental crust. Which density relationship is generally expected?
choices: The continental sample is always denser

questions.question: Why are laboratory measurements at high pressure useful for Earth-interior research?
choices: They let researchers directly visit the core
They replace all need for seismic observations
They help test how materials behave under deep-Earth conditions
They prove surface pressure equals core pressure
